Both inputs are therefore shifted up 0.35 V with matched 2 uA mirrors into 175 k resistors, and the fb-side injection is compensated in R1. An NMOS 5T OTA then swings the gate to about 0.3 V. Miller Cc makes the gate pole dominant, so UGF ~140 kHz < gm_pass,min/CL ~400 kHz. A 100 uA divider bleed lifts gm_pass at light load. Iq ~ 135 uA."}

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_pair": (18.0, 10.0, 24.0),     # EA input pair gm/Id (weak/moderate inversion)
    "L_pair":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "I_tail":    (10e-6, 4e-6, 24e-6),   # EA tail current
    "Cc":        (40e-12, 15e-12, 100e-12),  # Miller cap gate->vout
    "gmid_pass": (13.0, 8.0, 16.0),      # pass gm/Id at max load (sets W)
    "I_div":     (100e-6, 50e-6, 130e-6),# divider bleed (light-load gm_pass)
    "vshift":    (0.35, 0.25, 0.45),     # input level shift
    "I_sh":      (2e-6, 1e-6, 5e-6),     # level-shift current per side
}

def _vsg_for(lt, W, L, I, vds):
    lo, hi = 0.1, 1.9
    for _ in range(40):
        mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        try:
            r = lt.op("p", W, L, mid, vds)
            idv = abs(r["Id"])
        except Exception:
            return None
        if idv < I:
            lo = mid
        else:
            hi = mid
    return 0.5 * (lo + hi)

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vref = spec.get("vref", 0.6)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    ilmin = spec.get("iload_min", 50e-6)
    ilmax = spec.get("iload_max", 5e-3)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 1e-9)
    vtgt = spec.get("vout_target", 1.2)

    Ish = p["I_sh"]
    Idiv = p["I_div"]
    It = p["I_tail"]
    Ipair = It / 2.0
    Rs = p["vshift"] / Ish
    vin_cm = vref + p["vshift"]

    # ---- bias: IREF -> NMOS diode; NMOS mirrors; PMOS diode -> shift sources
    mn0 = lut.size("n", 12, 1.0, iref, vds=0.7)                 # ibias diode
    mtl = lut.size("n", 12, 1.0, It, vds=0.3)                   # tail
    mn1 = lut.size("n", 12, 1.0, Ish, vds=0.8)                  # sink for PMOS diode
    mp0 = lut.size("p", 12, 2.0, Ish, vds=1.0)                  # PMOS diode
    mps = lut.size("p", 12, 2.0, Ish, vds=1.8 - vin_cm)         # shift sources

    # ---- error amp: NMOS pair + PMOS mirror load
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_pair"], p["L_pair"], Ipair, vds=0.4)
    m3 = lut.size("p", 12, 1.0, Ipair, vds=0.9)

    # ---- pass device
    Ihv = ilmax + Idiv
    mpass = lut.size("p", p["gmid_pass"], 0.15, Ihv, vds=0.5)
    Wp = mpass.W
    mfp = max(1, min(200, int(math.ceil(Wp / 40.0))))

    # ---- divider with compensation for Ish injected into fb
    R2 = vref / Idiv
    R1 = (vtgt - vref) / (Idiv - Ish)
    beta = vref / vtgt

    n = Netlist("vin vout vref vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.dev("MN0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mn0)
    n.dev("MTL", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mtl)
    n.dev("MN1", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mn1)
    n.dev("MP0", "pb", "pb", "vin", "vin", mp0)
    n.dev("MPA", "inp", "pb", "vin", "vin", mps)   # vref side shift
    n.dev("MPB", "inn", "pb", "vin", "vin", mps)   # fb side shift
    n.R("RSA", "inp", "vref", Rs)
    n.R("RSB", "inn", "fb", Rs)
    # error amp (fb side -> diode side => out rises when vout rises)
    n.dev("M1", "nd", "inn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "gate", "inp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "nd", "nd", "vin", "vin", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "gate", "nd", "vin", "vin", m3)
    # pass + compensation + divider
    n.dev("MPASS", "vout", "gate", "vin", "vin", mpass, m=mfp)
    n.C("CC", "gate", "vout", p["Cc"])
    n.R("R1", "vout", "fb", R1)
    n.R("R2", "fb", "vss", R2)

    # ---- predictions
    Aea = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    Ilt = ilmin + Idiv - Ish
    vsg_h = mpass.vgs
    vsg_l = _vsg_for(lut, Wp, 0.15, Ilt, 0.6)
    gm_l = None
    if vsg_l is not None:
        try:
            gm_l = abs(lut.op("p", Wp, 0.15, vsg_l, 0.6)["gm"])
        except Exception:
            gm_l = None
    if gm_l is None:
        gm_l = 18.0 * Ilt
        vsg_l = vsg_h - 0.35
    dvg = max(vsg_h - vsg_l, 0.05)
    load_reg = dvg / (Aea * beta) / (ilmax - ilmin)

    Cg = mpass.cgg
    ugf = beta * m1.gm / (2 * PI * p["Cc"])
    p2 = gm_l / (2 * PI * cl * (1 + Cg / p["Cc"]))
    zr = gm_l / (2 * PI * p["Cc"])
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugf / p2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugf / zr))

    iq = iref + It + Ish + 2 * Ish + (Idiv - Ish)
    verr = 100 * (dvg / 2) / (Aea * beta) / vtgt

    # worst-case headroom info (ss, -40C, 1.62 V)
    hd = None
    try:
        lss = lut.at("ss", -40)
        vsg_ss = _vsg_for(lss, Wp, 0.15, Ihv, 0.42)
        vgs_pair_ss = lss.size("n", p["gmid_pair"], p["L_pair"], Ipair, vds=0.3).vgs
        if vsg_ss is not None:
            hd = (1.62 - vsg_ss) - (vin_cm - vgs_pair_ss + 0.05)
    except Exception:
        hd = None

    tau = 1.0 / (2 * PI * ugf)
    ring = 0.4 * math.exp(-7e-6 / tau)

    pred = {
        "vout_err_pct": verr,
        "load_reg": load_reg,
        "iq": iq,
        "ripple_settled": ring,
        "ea_gain_db": db(Aea),
        "ugf_hz": ugf,
        "pm_deg_light": pm,
        "p2_light_hz": p2,
        "pass_W_um": Wp,
    }
    if hd is not None:
        pred["gate_headroom_ss_m40_V"] = hd
    return n, pred
```
